summary: A Quote subscription: a frame whose QUOTE packet is followed by a cut-short one gives the first packet's frame, and a QUOTE packet cut short is dropped.

notes: The web parses one packet per binary message from byte 0 (paytm_websocket.py:289-326) and drops a message whose packet is short (struct.error caught at :103-108).

deviations.reason: The web passes Paytm's trade time on in epoch seconds; WebSocket times are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md, CLAUDE.md), so a client reading ltt as ms on the web lands in January 1970. The desktop sends milliseconds.
